Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning


U.S. Bank does not allow the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) or Machine Learning (ML) tools during the interview (and any assessment) process that have not been approved by U.S. Bank. This includes the use of web-based AI/ML tools including, but not limited to, ChatGPT, Claude, Google Gemini, Otter and Perplexity. This prohibition on the use of unapproved AI/ML tools applies to candidates (whether internal or external) and any others involved in the recruiting process. Use of unapproved AI/ML may result in disqualification from the recruitment process.


By providing my email address and mobile phone number in this application, I consent to receive transactional and informational communications, including calls and email messages from U.S. Bank [and its affiliates and agents] in connection with any job for which I have applied.
